prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a huge red dragon standing tall and imposing, seen from the side and a little from the front: planted on its two thick hind legs with the chest lifted high and the forelegs raised in front of the chest with their claws curled, the long neck curved forward in a deep C so the horned head is held level with the top of the folded wings (not raised above them), looking down toward the heroes; crimson scales with darker red armour plating along the back, a ridged cream belly, two great bat-like wings with dark red membranes folded up close behind the shoulders (their tips below the head), two backward- curving ivory horns, a row of pale bone spikes from the head down the neck and back, burning yellow eyes, a long tail curled on the ground behind the hind feet; the wing tips and the horn tips are the highest points and stay below the top of the grey box, with empty background above them as tall as the head, and the dragon sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides; palette of crimson, dark red, cream, ivory and yellow. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the horned red head with a burning yellow eye, a clear bright spot, is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, striking down toward the heroes from its tall stance: the neck arching forward and down so the head with the jaws open lunges low in front of its chest, the forelegs reaching forward with the claws spread, the hind legs planted, the wings still folded close, a small flicker of flame drawn inside the open jaws; never taller than the idle cell; the whole dragon well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, recoiling: the neck pulled back, the head tossed to the side with the eyes shut, the forelegs drawn in against the chest, the hind legs planted, the wings folded tight; a little lower than in the idle cell, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Keep the tall, upright stance of the idle cell in every cell: the hind legs planted, the chest high, the long neck raised; the action is in the neck, the head, the forelegs and the wings, which stay folded close to the body; the whole dragon stays inside its own cell and never taller than in the idle cell (no leap, no flying). Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, flying, a leap, spread wings in open air, a rider, a breath of fire in open air, smoke, two heads, white scales, blue scales, green scales, violet, purple, pink, magenta, a ground line, a floor.
